 Top trending Kalshi markets for November
 Kalshi offers hundreds of markets covering everything from sports and politics to economics, weather and pop culture. Here’s a look at some of the markets getting the most attention right now, including NFL contracts and the upcoming NBA season.
 Sports: NFL, college football, college basketball, NHL, NBA, UFC and more. Futures run from the NBA title to the CFP championship to the Super Bowl.
 Politics and crypto: Election markets, plus short-window Bitcoin price markets that settle through the day. World events are fair game too.
 Culture: Movie awards, reality TV eliminations, music and more.
 Prices move as news breaks and traders react, so a contract can cost more or less depending on when you trade.
 What is Kalshi?
 Kalshi is a prediction market exchange regulated by the CFTC. You aren’t betting against a house. You buy and sell contracts with other traders. Every contract is priced between $0 and $1, and the price reflects how likely the market thinks an outcome is. A correct contract settles at $1. An incorrect one settles at $0.
 That exchange setup is the biggest difference from a sportsbook. The operator doesn’t set the price, and you can sell a contract before the event ends to lock in a gain or cut a loss.
 How do Kalshi contracts work?
 Say a contract is priced at 80 cents. That implies an 80% chance of the event happening. Ten shares cost $8. If you’re right, they pay out $10, a $2 profit. If you’re wrong, they pay nothing.
 Prices shift by the minute, so the same contract can cost something different an hour later. You also don’t have to wait for the event to be decided. You can sell at the current price whenever you want.
 Is Kalshi legal and where is it available?
 Kalshi operates under federal CFTC oversight as a designated contract market, so it is available across most of the United States. Because it is regulated at the federal level rather than state by state, it reaches some places where traditional sports betting is not yet live.
 As of November 2026, the  Kalshi promo code DISPATCH , one of the top  prediction market promos , is available in 38 states plus Washington, D.C. It is not currently available in Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, Ohio, Utah and Washington. Sports-market access is the subject of ongoing legal challenges, so this list can change.
 Kalshi promo code DISPATCH FAQ
 What is the Kalshi promo code?
 The Kalshi promo code is DISPATCH . New users who deposit $10 and complete $25 in trades receive a $25 bonus credit, regardless of whether those trades win or lose.
 How do I get the Kalshi bonus?
 Sign up with Kalshi promo code DISPATCH , deposit at least $10 and trade $25 in event contracts. The bonus is credited no matter how the contracts settle.
 Is Kalshi a sportsbook?
 No. Kalshi is a prediction market exchange where users trade contracts against other users, not against a house.
 Is Kalshi legit and safe?
 Yes. Kalshi is a designated contract market regulated by the CFTC, the federal agency that oversees U.S. futures and derivatives exchanges.
 How does Kalshi work?
 Users buy and sell yes-or-no contracts on real-world events such as sporting events, elections, award shows, etc. Each contract is priced between $0 and $1, the price reflects the implied probability of the outcome. A correct contract settles at $1.
 How much does Kalshi cost?
 Kalshi does not charge a fee to use its platform, but it collects small fees on trades and charges about 2% for certain deposit methods.
 Where is Kalshi legal?
 Kalshi is available in 38 states plus Washington, D.C. It is not currently available in Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, Ohio, Utah and Washington.
